purpose: Documentation-only PR that replaces the non-existent `pr-review` mode with the implemented `analyze` mode in the README mode lists and adds `/analyze` to the App's slash-command list.
riskRationale: Pure documentation change in README.md; no code, behavior, or security surface is affected. The main risk is incompleteness: the file named in the issue title (`action/action.yml`) is left unfixed.

text: The README edits are accurate and verified: `analyze` is a real mode (`lib/src/types/index.ts:710`, `action/src/inputs.ts:8`, `action/src/index.ts:270`) and `/analyze` is a real App command (`app/src/subscribers/analyze.ts`, `app/src/handlers/commands.ts:73`). However, the PR does not fix the file its own issue title targets, and its description makes a factually incorrect claim about action.yml. The two `action.yml` files have drifted and only the top-level one lists all six modes.

reasoning: The primary deliverable of issue #244 — fixing the incomplete `mode` description in `action/action.yml` — was not completed, and the PR description falsely claims action.yml already lists all valid modes. README changes themselves are correct and safe to merge.

message: Correctly removes the documentation-only artifact `pr-review`, which does not exist in the type system (`lib/src/types/index.ts:710`) or validation (`action/src/inputs.ts:8`), and replaces it with the fully implemented `analyze` mode.

The added `/analyze` command is verified to exist: `app/src/subscribers/analyze.ts` routes `/analyze` comments and `app/src/handlers/commands.ts:73` implements the `analyze` case. The command description matches `handleAnalyzeCommand`'s purpose.

The issue this PR claims to fix is titled "action.yml 'mode' description is incomplete - missing 'analyze' mode", yet no `action.yml` was modified. `action/action.yml:10` still reads `'Action mode: review, fix, audit, or post'` — missing both `analyze` and `self-heal`. The PR description's claim that "The `action.yml` already listed all valid modes" is only true of the top-level `action.yml:10`; the two files have drifted (this drift is documented as a known issue in `docs/improvement/deferent-agent/IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md:106`), and `action/action.yml` is the copy attached to releases (`.github/workflows/release.yml:343`). Leaving the file named in the issue title unfixed means the primary deliverable is unaddressed.
suggestion: Update the mode description in `action/action.yml:10` to list all six valid modes, matching the top-level `action.yml` and the VALID_MODES array in `action/src/inputs.ts:8`.
suggestionCode: description: 'Action mode: review, fix, audit, post, analyze, or self-heal'

message: The mode list omits `self-heal`, which is a fully implemented, valid mode (`lib/src/types/index.ts:710`, `action/src/inputs.ts:8`, and dispatched in `action/src/index.ts:302`). Given the PR's stated goal of accurately listing all implemented modes, documenting only five of the six valid modes leaves the README incomplete — the same omission also affects line 76.
suggestion: Append `self-heal` to the mode lists on README.md:76 and README.md:84 so the documentation matches the type system exactly (e.g., `One of: review, fix, audit, analyze, post, self-heal`).
